content:
harper: Heads-up — hit dup-create on the onboarding flow in our sample app when token rotate overlaps a fast retry (min jitter ~40ms). Repro attached below.

harper: short repro: signup -> trigger createProfile -> 429 -> client retries quickly -> auth refresh completes -> server records two profiles for same user.

leo: yikes. which SDK?

harper: sampleapp is JS (node sdk v0.9.2) but customer reported similar in a small Go CLI. looks parity-related.

anya: probable cause: replay/idempotency header is added before retry middleware in old code, but after auth-refresh in newer retry stack. If refresh rebuilds the outgoing request, the header can be dropped.

morgan: can you paste the important logs?

harper: logs: \n```\n2026-03-10T15:01:10Z INFO request start id=rqH1 auth=stale
2026-03-10T15:01:11Z WARN 429 id=rqH1 backoff=40ms
2026-03-10T15:01:11Z INFO auth rotated for session=sess42
2026-03-10T15:01:11Z INFO retry id=rqH1 headers=(authorization: Bearer xyz123) // x-rw-replay-id MISSING
2026-03-10T15:01:11Z INFO server created profile for user=123 duplicate=true
```\n
leo: ok that matches a race where the auth client instance replaces request-level metadata on refresh.

anya: proposed fix: generate a per-logical-request replay id at the start of the high-level API call and put it in request context so it survives any auth or transport rebuilds. e.g.:
```js
// pseudo-node
const replayId = opts.headers['x-rw-replay-id'] || uuid();
const ctx = { ...req.ctx, replayId };
req.setHeader('x-rw-replay-id', replayId);
await auth.ensureValidToken(ctx);
return transport.send(req.withContext(ctx));
```

morgan: also need to clarify semantics cross-SDK: header name, lifecycle, and whether streaming uses seq numbers. I'll file a tiny spec.

harper: short-term mitigation: bump onboarding sampleapp 429 min backoff to 200ms so we avoid typical refresh window (50-150ms). But not ideal for production.

leo: agree long-term = SDK change + parity roll. Immediate: add a CI test that simulates token rotation mid-retry and asserts no duplicate side-effects. We should also add a small e2e scenario in sampleapp CI.

anya: on parity: add a spec doc with 3 snippets (node/go/python) showing where to inject header (before auth middleware) and how to preserve it during refresh. Also call out streaming case: add x-rw-replay-seq per chunk for resumable uploads.

morgan: created ticket DEVEX-4890 cross-sdk replay-id parity. assigning to eng-platform + devex.

harper: i'll open a small PR for node: (1) attach replay id at API boundary, (2) carry in context through auth refresh, (3) unit + integration test. will ping for review.

ci-bot: PR harper/fix/replay-id -> ci/presubmit queued (3 checks)

leo: after node lands, we'll produce a short migration note and update onboarding sampleapp. low friction for customers: bump default retry jitter on sampleapp until all SDKs have fix.

anya: also add metrics: duplicate_creates_per_100k for profile/create endpoints and a dashboard. alert if >1 per 100k.

harper: thanks folks. attaching repro harness and logs to the PR. :thumbsup:
